artworks.title: In the Woods (Dans les bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a natural setting with dense brush and trees in an upward view. The style features etched lines creating a textured, layered look with a sketchy quality. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black, white, and gray. Vegetation is shown in the lower and middle sections with tall, slender trees dominating the background.

artworks.title: Tornado (Le typhon)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures and trees in a dynamic scene. The horizon is not visible, and the composition is filled with trees and human figures interacting with their surroundings. The style is detailed with controlled linework, cross-hatching for texture, and a monochrome color palette of sepia or brown. Closest to us are two figures, with one crouched holding sticks and the other in motion. Beyond them are more figures and contorted trees, with rough landscape elements in the background.

artworks.title: My Farm (Ma ferme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a slightly elevated perspective. The terrain slopes gently, leading to a horizon with faint tree outlines. The foreground shows detailed etchings of shrubbery and trees, with delicate lines suggesting movement. A structure with a pitched roof is nestled on a slope. The sepia-toned coloring enhances the tranquil and simple rural setting, with a lack of bold colors or dramatic contrasts.

artworks.title: Countryside of Burgundy [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view with a composition leading from left to right. On the left, dense foliage is depicted with intricate brushstrokes. The horizon is visible with a line of trees and low-lying vegetation. The sky is filled with textured clouds, covering the upper half of the artwork. The color palette consists of earth tones, mainly varying shades of brown. Cross-hatching techniques are used to bring depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: Return of the Peasants
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people and horses forming a caravan. The scene depicts several figures and horses journeying together. The figures are sketched with detailed attention to their attire and gestures, showing hunched postures and carrying heavy loads. A horse in the center carries a pack. The background suggests a landscape setting, possibly rural. Soft pencil strokes and fine lines create a sense of texture and depth in the drawing.

artworks.title: Thomas Carlyle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch of a male figure. The man faces forward with his head slightly turned to the side. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard with mustache. He wears a broad-brimmed hat and a dark cape or coat with a high collar. The background is plain, and in the bottom right corner, the name "A. Legros" is signed.

artworks.title: Harvesters Surprised by the Storm (Moissoneuses surprises par l'orage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with figures under trees. The perspective is slightly elevated, with a high horizon line. The drawing has delicate strokes, cross-hatching for texture, and a monochromatic palette of sepia and black. The figures are sheltered under windy trees.

artworks.title: Head of a Child
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper washed green
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a person's face, stopping above the shoulders. The person faces forward with a slight head tilt downwards. The face has well-defined features, including large eyes, a small nose, and a gentle smile. Their hair is long and flows down on both sides of the face with straight bangs across the forehead. The clothing is minimally detailed, with faint lines around the neck. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a plain surface with the artist's signature and the year "1893" in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing the upper half of a man's body, from the chest up. He is depicted in a seated, relaxed position, with his head slightly tilted upward and his gaze directed upwards as well. The man has distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose, cheekbones, a full beard, and short, neatly combed hair. He is wearing a jacket over a buttoned shirt. The surrounding area is plain, with subtle pencil strokes for shading. A signature, "A. Legros," is present in the top right corner of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Battle of Padua
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval cityscape. It includes a military encampment, city fortifications, and a series of fortified buildings and towers. The composition features tents, soldiers, trees, a winding path, city gates, and the large fortified city in the background. The lines in the drawing create detailed textures throughout. The color palette is primarily black lines on beige paper.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in gray and rose on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two figures near a well in a medieval setting. The image portrays a scene with two ornately dressed figures at a well. One figure is filling a vessel with water from the well, while the other gestures with a raised hand. The well is central, with elaborate stonework and an overhead roof made of rounded shingles. The background includes rolling hills, trees, a windmill, and castle-like buildings. The style features intricate patterns and stylized outlines typical of medieval artwork. This painting is reminiscent of a storybook, possibly reflecting the storytelling aspect of stained glass windows. This is in the style of Pieter Bruegel the Elder.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of Jesus in Bethany
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in brown lake, pale ochre, and light green
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 24.1 x 17.5 cm (9 1/2 x 6 7/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The artwork features a central figure on a cross flanked by two other figures also crucified alongside. At the feet of the central figure, there are several people with solemn expressions. The artwork is rich with intricate lines and detailed patterns. The color palette includes earthy tones such as browns, greens, and subtle reds. The figures wear garments that are intricately patterned.

artworks.title: The Union Cavalry and Artillery Starting in Pursuit of the Rebels up the Yorktown Turnpike
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Union cavalry and artillery pursuit. The image shows a group of soldiers on horseback riding energetically across a landscape towards the top left. In the background, a camp of military tents is visible, with figures and horse-drawn artillery present. Trees and open space provide a backdrop. The illustration is in black and white, utilizing lines and shading for detail.

artworks.title: The Last Days of Harvest
artworks.description: This image shows a rural harvest scene. Two figures are shucking corn on the ground, with scattered ears of corn and stalks around them. In the background, two adults are on a wagon attached to two horses. The horizon is high with clouds and birds in the sky. The etching style features intricate linework. The color palette is monochromatic using black, white, and gray. Cornfields and tall stalks are visible around the workers.

artworks.title: The Dinner Horn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person blowing a horn outside a building. The image features a figure at the entrance of a building calling into the distance with a horn. The person is dressed in late 19th-century clothing. A cat is walking nearby. The building has wooden siding, an open entrance, and light casting shadows inside. Ivy trails along the roof's edge. Fields stretch out towards the horizon under a light sky with clouds.

artworks.title: Gloucester Harbor
artworks.description: The image shows a boat on water, with children inside, some sitting and others with their legs hanging over the side. In the background, there are several sailing boats on the water, with distinct sails. The sky has soft clouds, and the color palette is sepia and black.

artworks.title: "Dad's Coming!"
artworks.description: The image is a coastal scene from a side viewpoint. A young boy sits on an overturned boat, looking out to sea. Several sailboats are visible on the horizon. A woman holding a child stands to the right near barrels and a fishing net. The sky above has detailed clouds, and the monochromatic color palette emphasizes texture and shading. The rocky shoreline and seaweed complete the scene.

artworks.title: A Winter-Morning, - Shovelling Out
artworks.artist: George A. Avery after Winslow Homer
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with a snow-covered landscape. In the foreground, two figures dressed in dark clothing and hats are shoveling a pathway through deep snow. One person is holding a shovel upright while the other is clearing snow. On the right, a woman is tossing snow onto the side. The horizon is obscured by snow and trees, with cottages in the background. The style of the image is reminiscent of an engraving, with detailed lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and grey. Bare trees frame the view, and distant trees and structures are blurred.

artworks.title: Deer-Stalking in the Adirondacks in Winter
artworks.description: The image shows two men in winter attire trekking with snowshoes through a snow-covered forest. The viewpoint is elevated, offering a perspective of the men and the surroundings. The forest, with trees and branches, frames the scene with a dense background. The artwork features detailed textures like tree bark and fabric of clothing. The color scheme is monochromatic, primarily using browns and beige. In the distance, a deer is running, adding movement to the scene.

artworks.title: Winter at Sea - Taking in Sail Off the Coast
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of sailors securing sails on a ship. The image depicts several sailors working on a large cloth sail that is stretched out across the ship's rigging. They are engaged in an action on the sea. The background features a starry night sky. The lines and shading techniques used create a textured, detailed scene that captures movement and effort. The drawing is marked by the name Homer.

artworks.title: Fall Games - The Apple-Bee
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor gathering with people engaging in various activities involving apples. The setting is a rustic and festive room with decorations, creating a warm atmosphere. The individuals are seated at tables, participating in what appears to be a harvest celebration. The drawing highlights traditional clothing and interactions among the participants.

artworks.title: Gathering Berries
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals gathering berries in a natural landscape. The scene depicts a group of people engaging in the activity of berry picking in an open field. The landscape includes elements such as bushes and possibly small hills or mountains in the background. A sailboat can be seen in the distance on a body of water. The sky is filled with clouds. The individuals in the drawing are illustrated with attention to detail in their clothing. This is a black and white drawing.

artworks.title: On the Beach at Long Branch - The Children's Hour
artworks.artist: James L. Langridge after Winslow Homer
artworks.description: The image features several figures, including two women, a child, and a baby. One woman is kneeling holding an umbrella over the child. The child is standing facing the woman. Another woman stands behind them, and she is holding a baby. Other people can be seen in the background on a sandy beach with umbrellas and a view of the ocean and distant land under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Thanksgiving in Camp
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men in military uniforms gathered around a table and campfire. They are engaged in various activities such as sitting, leaning on boxes, and standing. Some men have hair of different lengths and wear hats. The men wear dark-colored jackets, trousers, and boots, with some accessories. Some are holding mugs or canteens, and a pipe is on the table. In the background, a tent with signs saying "Herrings" and "Cider" is visible, along with other tents and horses under a sky with clouds.
